parsed.post: Discarding DEPTH=8 run (val_bpb 1.044626) as it performed worse than DEPTH=6 (1.014776). Increasing capacity too much per 5-min budget might prevent convergence. Reverting to DEPTH=6. Next, I'll probe MATRIX_LR=0.03 to see if a lower learning rate helps the higher-capacity model stabilize.
parsed.description: Reverting to DEPTH=6 (previous best) and decreasing MATRIX_LR to 0.03 to check if lower LR improves convergence for the capacity-optimized model.
